world: Kowhai — an Earth-sized Kano world with 28.37% land

places.name: The River Meadow
places.hook: Stand on the dry grassy bank and look west across the river toward the woodland. Press I to ask why water and soil collect here.

places.name: The Low Shore
places.hook: Fly over low coastal ground, following water between sandy banks and scattered plants. Press F to land; E and C change your height.

places.name: The Rainy Forest
places.hook: A cool, rain-rich region with conifers and a grassy understory. Inspect a tree with the right mouse button and compare its recipe with this place's climate.

places.name: The Limestone Woodland
places.hook: Warm limestone country with open grass and scattered branching plants. Ask about the rock, soil and life rather than expecting a closed canopy.

places.name: The Clay Woodland
places.hook: View the warm woodland from above, then descend to inspect it. Compare its clay-rich ground and plant life with the limestone stop.

places.name: The Cool Taiga
places.hook: Cool northern forest on sloping ground. The arrival is above the hillside so the view stays clear; descend with C when you find an open patch.

places.name: The Snow Plateau
places.hook: High, cold terrain with snow and sparse low plants. Ask how elevation changes the climate, then compare it with the river meadow.
